cut: In src/init.rs, have both modes produce the token and vault, then build the Store, run the checks, and render the answer once, adding the saved-file note only after a write. In src/store.rs and src/init.rs, replace vaults() with a presence check over the JSON response and remove the intermediate Vec<String>. In src/access.rs, share the GetSecurityInfo call, status handling, and Descriptor ownership between the Windows access check and restrict. In tests/init.rs, return Ran directly from the submission helper and assert the link announcement against Ran.stderr.
answer: Made all four: init and --check share one path (enter() for the link, then save, store, checks and the answer once, the kept-file note only after a write); Store::has_vault checks the JSON in place; access.rs has one security() helper for entries and restrict; the test helper returns Ran and asserts the link line on its stderr
